title: Optimizing Next.js Performance: A Practical Guide
content:
# Optimizing Next.js Performance Performance optimization is crucial for modern web applications. Here are practical strategies I've used in production Next.js apps. ## Server Components by Default Use server components wherever possible. They reduce the JavaScript bundle size: ```tsx export default async function Page() { const data = await fetchData(); return
{data.map(item => )}
; } ``` ## Image Optimization Always use Next.js Image component for automatic optimization: ```tsx import Image from "next/image"; ``` ## ISR for Dynamic Content Incremental Static Regeneration gives you the best of both worlds: ```tsx export const revalidate = 3600; ``` These optimizations can reduce Lighthouse scores from 60 to 95+.
excerpt: Practical strategies for optimizing Next.js applications including server components, image optimization, and ISR.
